description: This is a Java unit test class for testing the DeleteThingDefinition class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package. It contains test methods verifying immutability, equals/hashCode, creation from null or valid arguments, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overall behavior of the class.

classes.name: DeleteThingDefinitionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing DeleteThingDefinition behavior and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DeleteThingDefinition instances are immutable and that ThingId instances used are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods for DeleteThingDefinition.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeleteThingDefinition with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Tests creating a DeleteThingDefinition with valid arguments and verifies the entity ID.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON output of DeleteThingDefinition matches the expected structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating DeleteThingDefinition from a valid JSON string and verifies correctness.
